{"metadata":{"description":"VPS & SSH manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): zero-token /vps- commands, an in-conversation web terminal, and AI server ops with risk-tiered confirmation. 在 DSH 里像 SSH 一样无感地用 VPS：零 token 命令、对话内终端、AI 分级确认运维。","id":"gh:1372623456","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-vps-manager","slug":"AIcivilization/dsh-vps-manager","topics":["ai","ai-agent","ai-agents","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","linux","self-hosted","selfhosted","selfhosted-vpn","ssh","terminal","vless","vmess","vmess-ws","vpn","vps"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"VPS & SSH manager plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): zero-token /vps- commands, an in-conversation w"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"eb terminal, and AI server ops with risk-tiered confirmation. 在 DSH 里像 SSH 一样无感地用 VPS：零 token 命令、对话内"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"and AI server ops with risk-tiered confirmation. 在 DSH 里像 SSH 一样无感地用 VPS：零 token 命令、对话内终端、AI 分级确认运维。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-vps-manager"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Use your VPS inside DeepSeek Harness as seamlessly as over SSH: curated zero-token commands, plus "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"the AI in the conversation can operate the server.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**在 DSH 中和 SSH 一样无感地使用 VPS，除了精选的部分常用命令之外，使用时还能让对话中的大模型对 VPS 进行操作。**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Install**: search for `dsh-vps-manager` in the DSH plugin market and click install; or quit DSH co"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"mpletely and run the line below in a terminal (for command-line `dsh web`, replace `desktop` with `w"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"eb`; see Install). Then open DSH and add a machine under **Settings → VPS Manager**."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Manage your VPS from DeepSeek Harness (DSH): check server status with commands that skip the model a"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nd cost no tokens, tell the AI what to do and let it work on the server, see how the server is doing"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" on one page, open a real terminal or move files in the conversation when you want to do it yourself"},{"id":"p9s4","text":", and handle common installs and maintenance with recipes."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**It works with DSH on Windows, macOS and Linux**, in both DSH Desktop and command-line `dsh web`, a"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"nd several computers (home, office) can manage the same server at the same time."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"You enter the password once when adding a machine; from then on everything uses SSH key login and sh"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ares one execution mechanism: operations that change things run as remote tasks and keep going if th"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"e connection drops; changes on the same machine run one at a time; config files are backed up before"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" they are edited; an automatic restore is set up on the server before firewall or SSH changes; and e"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"very run is written to an audit log."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> **Want DSH itself running on your VPS?** See the sister project dsh-vps: one command on the VPS in"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"stalls stock DSH behind a login page with automatic HTTPS, reachable from any browser, with settings"},{"id":"p12s3","text":", API keys and the plugin market all working, and new DSH releases upgraded with one click in the pa"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ge. The two work together: install this plugin in the DSH on your VPS and manage that server right f"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"rom the conversation."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## At a glance"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Capability | What it does |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Zero-token commands | 22 `/vps-` commands: check status, install software, reboot and wait for the"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" machine to come back, without touching the model |
| VPS mode | One click in the conversation heade"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"r and that conversation operates the server; each conversation has its own binding, so one window ca"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"n work on the server while another keeps working on local code |
| Real connection state | Header sq"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"uares: grey not selected · yellow connecting · green connected · red unreachable, with the reason an"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"d a retry button |
| Terminal in the conversation | A real terminal (xterm.js over `ssh -tt`) where "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"menu scripts, `top` and `vim` work; red / yellow / green buttons to end, minimize and maximize; noth"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ing lost when you minimize or switch conversations, and it reconnects after a drop |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Three screenshots take turns here (1 → 2 → 3); click to step through them on the project page. Full "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"size: 1 · 2 · 3
1 Settings → VPS Manager: the numbered machines · 2 Files below the conversation, VP"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"S status kept in the right sidebar · 3 Where the main controls are"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"From installing the plugin to reaching the first machine (the address and user name in the recording"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"he plugin to reaching the first machine (the address and user name in the recording are blacked out)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 or later (up to 0.2.x), DSH Desktop or `dsh web`
- Windows, macOS or L"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"inux (see Platforms below)
- Node.js >= 22.13
- **Everyday logins use an SSH key.** A password is us"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ed only once, when adding a machine, to put the key in place. `sudo` that asks for a password is not"},{"id":"p20s4","text":" supported
- Operations that change the system need the remote user to be `root` or to have password"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"less `sudo`; read-only queries do not"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **One engine, three entry points**: the settings page, `/vps-` commands and the AI tools share one"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" execution engine. Scripts reach the server on SSH's standard input and are written to a file before"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" they run, so no outside data is ever spliced into the remote command line
- **Shared connections**:"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" each machine uses one SSH master connection (OpenSSH ControlMaster), so commands and connection che"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"cks over it take tens of milliseconds. The OpenSSH that ships with Windows cannot share connections,"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" so there each command connects afresh
- **Remote tasks**: operations that change things run as task"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"s under `~/.cache/dsh-vps/` on the server, with a lock, and keep going after a disconnect; you can r"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"eattach and read the log at any time
- **Several computers**: the lock, task records, backups and tr"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ash live on the server, so the plugins on every computer see the same ones and changes queue automat"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"ically
- **Terminal**: the pseudo-terminal is requested on the server with `ssh -tt`, and the browse"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"r reaches the plugin over a WebSocket; if the connection drops, the session is kept for a while and "},{"id":"p22s12","text":"the missed output is replayed on reconnect
- **What the model is told**: when a conversation enters "},{"id":"p22s13","text":"VPS mode, the plugin gives the model that machine's system, services, containers and the rules it mu"},{"id":"p22s14","text":"st follow; in VPS mode the model cannot use local bash"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What it does not protect against"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Risk-level confirmation guards against AI mistakes, not against an AI set on getting around it.*"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"* Static analysis cannot recognise every disguised form, and the model can also use DSH's own bash t"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ool to ssh into the server directly
- **DSH's sandbox does not cover the ssh processes this plugin s"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"tarts itself**
- **Nothing typed in the terminal goes through risk-level confirmation.** You are typ"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ing the commands yourself, exactly as in SSH, and the plugin does not intercept them
- **There is no"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" general rollback.** What you have is file backups, the connectivity safety net and recipes that can"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" be run again. Take a snapshot in your provider's console before reinstalling the OS, upgrading to a"},{"id":"p24s8","text":" new major release, or repartitioning"}],"truncated":true}
